notes: Read all 14 source lines line by line. The web file is the vehicle-detail barrel: lines 1-14 are `export { X } from './X'` re-exports of the 14 page section components (L1 VehicleHeader, L2 BatteryRangePanel, L3 LiveStateIndicators, L4 QuickStatsGrid, L5 MotorSection, L6 ClimateSection, L7 SecuritySection, L8 TirePressureSection, L9 ChargingTelemetrySection, L10 BatteryRangeCharts, L11 RecentDrivesSection, L12 RecentChargesSection, L13 VehicleConfigSection, L14 QuickLinksSection); the trailing blank line is a no-op. Every one of the 14 export names is preserved as a named export of the native barrel.

Because none of the 14 vehicle-detail siblings have been converted to native yet, this barrel follows the established precedent for a barrel whose siblings are unported (the components/a11y and components/motion barrels were likewise self-contained .ts modules at creation time): a SELF-CONTAINED native-safe .ts module. Later per-component conversions are expected to extract these into sibling .tsx files and slim this barrel to re-exports. The conversion contract mandates `index.ts`, and a .ts file cannot contain JSX, so every element is built with React.createElement (aliased `h`).

Reused already-ported native-safe components instead of reimplementing: GlassPanel + AppText (native shared components/ui), Badge (web-parity/components/ui/Badge, variant/dot/size API matches the source), RadialGauge (web-parity/components/charts/RadialGauge, value/max/label/unit/color/size API matches), DataTable + Column (web-parity/components/ui/DataTable, rendered via TS 4.7 instantiation-expression aliases DataTable<Drive>/DataTable<ChargingSession> with tableId/columns/data/keyExtractor/compact/pagination/emptyMessage), and useSettings (web-parity/api/hooks).

react-i18next useTranslation -> local key-preserving fallback shim returning the inline English copy with {{token}} interpolation (SecuritySection L7 windowsOpen {{count}}); every i18n key + English default from all 14 sources is preserved verbatim.

@/hooks/useUnits -> local shim over useSettings exposing formatDistance/formatSpeed/formatTemperature/formatPressure (+ settings-precision-bound fmtNumber/fmtInt and unitPrefs.distance). SI converters (convertDistanceFromSI/convertSpeedFromSI/convertTempFromSI/convertPressureFromSI/convertEnergyFromSI) and the formatX precision/locale logic are inlined verbatim from @/lib/unitConversion (NIST constants METERS_PER_MILE/KM/FOOT, KPA_PER_PSI/BAR, DEFAULT_PRECISION distance1/speed0/temp1/pressure1, SI-floor contract: meters/m·s⁻¹/°C/kPa/Wh in). No Mi/Mph/Kwh suffixes introduced; conversion only at the display boundary.

@/hooks/useFormatting -> local shim exposing formatCurrency from settings.currency_symbol + decimal_precision (verbatim logic), used by RecentChargesSection L12 cost column. @/lib/numberFormat fmtNumber/fmtInt and @/lib/dateFormat formatDate/formatDateTime are inlined as locale-aware Intl ports.

./helpers (a separate unported module) inlined verbatim for the parts these components use: batteryColor (60/25 thresholds -> #10b981/#f59e0b/#ef4444), the SI-Pa TIRE_PRESSURE_PA threshold table, paToKpa (Pa->kPa /1000), tirePressureVariant (neutral/danger/warning/success), and durationStr. SecuritySection's windowOpenCount predicate is inlined verbatim.

MetricCard/AnimatedNumber/KVList (data-display) + EmptyState/Skeleton (feedback) -> local View-based shims reproducing the web look. MetricCard drops the decorative lucide icon (the label carries meaning, per the EnergyChargingPanel sibling precedent) and surfaces the color prop (cyan/green/purple) as a small leading dot; AnimatedNumber renders the final formatted value statically (native has no rAF count-up); EmptyState mirrors the message(+optional icon) API; Skeleton renders lines x height placeholder bars. All field reads, null guards (?? '—'), unit strings (V/A/kW/kWh/Nm/%/RPM), color branches, and the EmptyState no-action intent are preserved.

BatteryRangeCharts (L10): Recharts (BarChart/AreaChart/ResponsiveContainer/Area/Bar/XAxis/YAxis/CartesianGrid/Tooltip/Legend) is forbidden on native (rule 4). The RadialGauge + battery%/range AnimatedNumber stats are reproduced faithfully; the battery bar chart becomes two proportional View CompositionBars (Current accent / Remaining violet) and the drive-distance trend becomes View bars scaled to max distance with date labels (the same useMemo-built driveChartData: formatDate(start_ts), convertDistanceFromSI(distance_m,pref) rounded, duration_s/60 rounded, reversed), with EmptyState when empty. Documented in nativeVehicleDetailCapabilities.rechartsAvailable=false.

react-router-dom Link (VehicleHeader back link, RecentDrives/RecentCharges 'View all', QuickLinks 6 cards) -> native has no DOM router, so NavLink renders an accessibilityRole='link' View that preserves the visual + a11y intent but does not navigate; the `to` target is retained in intent for a future React Navigation wiring (nativeVehicleDetailCapabilities.domRouterNavigationAvailable=false). VehicleHeader's wake Button keeps its real onWake/waking behaviour via a Pressable with disabled/busy a11y state. lucide-react icons become decorative emoji glyphs (accessibilityElementsHidden).

No DOM modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, react-router-dom, framer-motion, or old web UI components are imported. Only React, react-native primitives, the native theme tokens, native shared GlassPanel/AppText, and the already-ported native-safe Badge/RadialGauge/DataTable/useSettings/api-types are used. Verified by cd apps/native; npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
